description: Resume a bulk campaign that was stopped (cancel_campaign / Cancel in the panel), finished with recipients left unsent, stopped because its template header file was missing, or paused because the plan's monthly message limit was used up (resume it after the plan is upgraded). Sends the campaign to every recipient who has not received it yet — real WhatsApp messages that Meta charges for. Requires confirm: call with confirm=false first to get a preview (how many people will be messaged, template, estimated Meta cost), show it to the user, then call again with confirm=true. Needs the Send Bulk add-on. Does NOT re-send to people already sent — use resend_campaign for that. Use get_campaign_status to see progress afterwards, cancel_campaign to stop it again.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to resume this campaign and message every recipient not reached yet.

window_ack.description: Required (true) only when the campaign is not an approved template and the workspace uses an official WhatsApp Cloud API number: Meta then delivers it only to contacts who messaged in the last 24 hours. Pass true only after telling the user that.

name: resume_campaign
